title: Monkey wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,32 62,32' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,32 56,32' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 47,32 53,32' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='#FF4757'/>
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x='37' y='30' width='26' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='22' fill='#A0724A'/>
  <!-- Face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#E8C99B'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='50' r='8' fill='#A0724A'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='50' r='4' fill='#E8C99B'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='50' r='8' fill='#A0724A'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='50' r='4' fill='#E8C99B'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='50' r='4' fill='#2C1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='4' fill='#2C1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='49' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='49' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#C4885A'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M44 62 Q50 68 56 62' stroke='#8A5A3A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='58' r='4' fill='#F4A0A0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='4' fill='#F4A0A0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#A0724A'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#E8C99B'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <path d='M34 80 Q24 76 22 68' stroke='#A0724A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 80 Q76 76 78 68' stroke='#A0724A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Hands -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='67' r='4' fill='#E8C99B'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='67' r='4' fill='#E8C99B'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8A5A3A'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8A5A3A'/>
</svg>
